verdict.rationale: Resend documents creating webhooks for real-time email event notifications and monitoring delivery events, which covers the general webhook-based event flow, but the evidence pack contains no documentation of specific event types like 'delivered', 'bounced', or 'complained', nor any description of retry/backoff behavior for failed webhook deliveries. missing for 10: explicit list of supported webhook event types (delivered/bounced/complained), documented retry policy/backoff schedule for failed webhook attempts, independent confirmation of retry behavior.
